name: communication-plan
description: Stakeholder communication plan — communication matrix (who / what / when / how / owner), reporting cadence (exec / sponsor / team / customer / regulator), dashboard design principles per audience, status-report templates (RAG + highlights + risks + asks), escalation paths (trigger / route / timeline), feedback-loop design (office hours / retros / surveys / open channels). Tailors style per audience. Hand-offs to demo-showcase-planning + change-impact-assessment + training-adoption-planning.
